citation.authors: Thind A, Pisudde PM, Kochhar S

cited_by.title: Coping with anxiety day to day

record.population: Medical students worldwide: 7 studies (1 randomised trial, 6 single-arm)
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of yoga breathing (pranayama)
record.finding: A large fall in perceived stress and anxiety (standardised mean difference -1.25) with high heterogeneity (67%). Only one study was randomised.
record.note: Mostly single-arm studies in medical students; ethnicity not given in the abstract; I did not read the full text.
